steps.say: The E-Type fixed-head: the long bonnet and fastback this coupe should keep.
Another Series I E-Type, for the covered round lamps and slim chrome.
Lancia Aurelia B20: restrained GT proportions, a softer roofline.
Aston Martin DB4 side view: the low waist and long wheelbase.
Ferrari 250 GT Lusso: the cleanest fastback of the era.
E-Type cockpit: wood rim, toggle switches, round dials - the cabin language to carry over.
Taycan side: how a modern EV coupe sits, wheels pushed to the corners.
Taycan cabin: the modern side of the interior, screens and a low dash.
Polestar 1 rear: a clean modern light bar to translate the round rear lamps.
Letting Muse read the references.
There is no car lens, so I ask Muse to propose one from these references.
The proposed lens names what matters here - bonnet length, roofline, lamp bezel, chrome, wheels, dash trim - so I confirm it.

args.text: New EV coupe, front three-quarter view from the front left, studio photo on a plain warm-grey background. Long bonnet and a fastback roofline like the 1961 E-Type and 250 GT Lusso, low waist and long wheelbase like the DB4, wheels pushed to the corners like the Taycan. Round headlamps under glass covers. A blanked front panel with a slim oval intake instead of a grille - it is electric. Restrained trim: thin brightwork only around the glass. Polished alloy wheels with a turbine pattern. Flush door handles. Paint: deep British racing green, gloss.
